# Assignment

-   Total annual stream flow

-   Total annual precipitation

-   \% of precipitation that becomes stream flow each year

## Set Up

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
# read in the data
p301 = read.csv(here("data", "p301.csv"))

# aggregate by water year
p301_yearly <- p301 %>%
  group_by(wy) %>%
  summarise(total_streamflow = sum(streamflow),
            total_precip = sum(precip),
            percent_streamflow = (total_streamflow / total_precip) * 100)

# calculate mean, range and standard deviation of percent streamflow across year
mean(p301_yearly$percent_streamflow)
```

## Find Annual Stream flow

```{r}
total_streamflow<- p301_yearly|>
  sum(streamflow)
```
